description: Skyway Air support documentation and staff discussion about unaccompanied minors.

files.description: A Confluence page in the customer-policies space for support agents about unaccompanied minors, last updated between 2026-09-08 and 2026-11-03. It must contain these sentences word for word: "A long manual (check-in, handover, escorts, delays); its last paragraph states the fee refund rule."; "required for ages 5 to 14"; "$150 per flight"; "refund the unaccompanied-minor fee when the trip is cancelled, whatever the reason". Do not state any other policy amount, limit, deadline or rule. Any example situation must fit these sentences: do not show anyone giving, arranging or refusing a hotel, meal, voucher, credit, refund or compensation beyond what they say, and do not set an example in a weather, air traffic control or airport security disruption unless they mention it. Do not mention lithium, power bank, power banks, watt-hour, watt-hours.
